name: MonarchAiTaskProgress
title: AiTaskProgress
wrapsNative: MonarchCard with MonarchBadge, MonarchProgress (androidx.compose.material3.LinearProgressIndicator), MonarchAiChainOfSteps, MonarchButton, androidx.compose.material3.FilterChip and androidx.compose.material3.IconButton; android.text.format.DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString for the start time
summary: A long-running assistant task in a card, with its status, a progress bar, when it started and how long is left, its steps, and controls to cancel, minimize or be notified.
whenToUse: For an assistant task that takes minutes, such as summarising many documents or an export, so people can follow it, leave it running and come back.
whenNotToUse: For a short wait inside a reply, use MonarchAiThinkingIndicator. For the steps alone, use MonarchAiChainOfSteps. For a file upload, use MonarchUploadQueue.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiTaskProgress(title: String, status: MonarchAiTaskStatus, startedAt: Long, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, steps: List<MonarchAiPlanStep> = emptyList(), progress: Float? = null, etaMillis: Long? = null, notifying: Boolean = false, now: Long? = null, onNotifyingChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, onMinimize: (() -> Unit)? = null, onCancel: (() -> Unit)? = null, statusIcon: (@Composable (MonarchAiTaskStatus) -> Unit)? = null, minimizeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiTaskProgressLabels = MonarchAiTaskProgressLabels())
enum class MonarchAiTaskStatus { Running, Paused, Done, Failed, Cancelled }

class MonarchAiTaskProgressLabels(status: ((MonarchAiTaskStatus) -> String)? = null, progressLabel: ((title: String) -> String)? = null, progressValue: ((percent: Int) -> String)? = null, started: ((relative: String) -> String)? = null, eta: ((millis: Long) -> String)? = null, cancel: String? = null, minimize: String? = null, notify: String? = null, announce: ((title: String, status: String) -> String)? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: What the task is, such as "Summarising 40 documents". A heading, and part of the bar's name.

options.name: status
options.description: Running, Paused, Done, Failed or Cancelled. Changes are announced.

options.name: startedAt
options.description: When the task started, in epoch milliseconds (UTC), shown as "Started 5 minutes ago".

options.name: steps
options.description: The steps, shown as a MonarchAiChainOfSteps. A task may have only a bar.

options.name: progress
options.description: Completion from 0 to 1. By default the share of finished (done, failed or skipped) steps; with no steps the bar is indeterminate while running.

options.name: etaMillis
options.description: Estimated time left in milliseconds, shown while running: "Less than a minute left", "About 3 minutes left", "About 2 hours left".

options.name: notifying
options.description: Whether "Notify me when done" is on.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time of the start text, for previews, tests and identical renders. The clock, refreshed every minute, when null.

options.name: onNotifyingChange
options.description: Shows the "Notify me when done" toggle while running or paused, and receives the new value.

options.name: onMinimize
options.description: Shows a Minimize button, for example to dock the task in a tray.

options.name: onCancel
options.description: Shows a Cancel button while the task runs or is paused.

options.name: statusIcon
options.description: An icon in the status badge. Decorative: the status is written.

options.name: minimizeIcon
options.description: Makes Minimize an icon button named "Minimize". Without it the button is written, because Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the status names, "<title> progress", "40% complete", "Started …", the time left, Cancel, Minimize, "Notify me when done" and the announcement (strings_aitaskprogress.xml).

states.name: running
states.description: Info badge; the bar fills, or is indeterminate without progress (still when animations are off); the time left is shown; Notify and Cancel are offered.

states.name: paused
states.description: Warning badge; no time left; Notify and Cancel are still offered.

states.name: done
states.description: Success badge; the bar is full; no controls but Minimize.

states.name: failed
states.description: Danger badge; the failure is announced assertively; no controls but Minimize.

states.name: cancelled
states.description: Neutral badge; the bar stays where it was or empty; no controls but Minimize.

appearance: A MonarchCard on the surface role with a subheading title, the status as a subtle MonarchBadge in its tone, a MonarchProgress bar in the tone of the status (accent while running) and muted caption text for the start, percentage and time left. Notify is a Material 3 filter chip in the theme; Cancel a secondary small MonarchButton. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: As on the web, the bar takes the tone of the status (accent while running). The running badge uses the AI tone, as the web's status pill does. The web's etaMs is etaMillis; startedAt and now are epoch milliseconds, as everywhere on Android. Hours left are whole hours, where the web writes one decimal. The web's children slot and stepsProps are not offered: put extra content after the card and pass ready steps. The web announces through live regions, and so does Android: a polite one, assertive for a failure. iOS's isNotifying binding is notifying with onNotifyingChange. The minimize icon is an optional slot because Monarch bundles no icons.
accessibility: The card is a traversal group; the title is a heading.
The status is a badge with its name in words, never color alone.
The bar is one element named "<title> progress" with "40% complete" as its state and the range as progress information, or the status name and indeterminate progress when there is no value.
A status change is announced as "<title>: <status>" through a live region that is always present: polite, assertive for a failure; the first status is not announced.
The steps announce their own starts and failures (MonarchAiChainOfSteps).

Notify is a filter chip whose selected state is read; Minimize is a written button or an icon button named "Minimize"; every control has a 48dp touch target and the controls wrap when they do not fit.
edgeCases: progress outside 0 to 1 is limited; NaN counts as unknown.
With no steps, no progress and a running status the bar is indeterminate; when paused or cancelled it is empty.
A negative etaMillis is not shown.
Without now the start text refreshes every minute.

examples.title: Running with steps
examples.template:
MonarchAiTaskProgress(
    title = {{title}},
    status = MonarchAiTaskStatus.{{status|pascal}},
    startedAt = {{startedAt|millis}},
    steps = listOf(
        MonarchAiPlanStep({{steps.0.id}}, {{steps.0.label}}, MonarchAiPlanStepState.{{steps.0.state|pascal}}),
        MonarchAiPlanStep({{steps.1.id}}, {{steps.1.label}}, MonarchAiPlanStepState.{{steps.1.state|pascal}}),
        MonarchAiPlanStep({{steps.2.id}}, {{steps.2.label}}),
        MonarchAiPlanStep({{steps.3.id}}, {{steps.3.label}}),
    ),
    etaMillis = {{etaMs}},
    notifying = notifying,
    now = {{now|millis}},
    onNotifyingChange = { notifying = it },
    onCancel = {},
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiTaskProgress(
    title = "Summarising 12 documents",
    status = MonarchAiTaskStatus.Running,
    startedAt = 1_767_268_620_000L,
    steps = listOf(
        MonarchAiPlanStep("0", "Collect the documents", MonarchAiPlanStepState.Done),
        MonarchAiPlanStep("1", "Summarise each document", MonarchAiPlanStepState.Active),
        MonarchAiPlanStep("2", "Write the overview"),
        MonarchAiPlanStep("3", "Check the figures"),
    ),
    etaMillis = 300_000,
    notifying = notifying,
    now = 1_767_268_800_000L,
    onNotifyingChange = { notifying = it },
    onCancel = {},
)

examples.title: A finished task
examples.code:
MonarchAiTaskProgress(
    title = "Export to CSV",
    status = MonarchAiTaskStatus.Done,
    startedAt = 1_763_100_000_000L,
    now = 1_763_100_600_000L,
    onMinimize = {},
)

parityExceptions.reason: The web step state pending is the native case todo (the default of MonarchAiPlanStep), written without the argument
parityExceptions.convention: naming: MonarchAiPlanStepState.todo is the web pending state, same meaning
